security_problem: Workload JWT-SVID JWKS fetched over cleartext non-loopback HTTP can be substituted. OIDC discovery that does not bind issuer or that advertises a cleartext jwks_uri can point attestation at attacker keys. A down or empty JWKS must not look ready.
required_behavior: serve accepts one of -spiffe-jwks, -spiffe-jwks-url, or -spiffe-oidc-issuer. JWKS and OIDC issuer URLs must be https except loopback http. OIDC discovery issuer and JWT iss must equal the configured issuer exactly (trailing slash is significant); jwks_uri is subject to the same URL check. Keys are re-fetched on each Attest. Empty JWKS fails closed. GET /readyz fails if a live attestor cannot load keys.
failure_behavior: Fail closed: non-https non-loopback JWKS/OIDC URLs, issuer mismatch, missing jwks_uri, empty JWKS, and an unreachable live attestor produce a process error at start or HTTP 503 on /readyz. JWT-SVID verification remains JWKS-based; this is not a SPIRE Workload API client.
